popCulture.title: Description of Greece
popCulture.creator: Pausanias
popCulture.description: Pausanias preserves the oracle of rain under a clear sky (aethra): Phalanthus understands when his wife Aethra weeps on his head, then takes Taras by night — the Spartan oecist of Tarentum.

popCulture.title: Phalanthus (founder of Tarentum)
popCulture.description: Leader of the Partheniae and legendary founder of Taranto — the Lacedaemonian who fulfills Delphi's riddle with his wife's tears.

popCulture.title: Taranto
popCulture.description: Ancient Taras — the prosperous harbor Phalanthus founds for the Partheniae, later first city of Magna Graecia.

popCulture.title: Partheniae
popCulture.description: The 'sons of the maidens' who sail with Phalanthus — Spartan youths of disputed birth who colonize Italy rather than rise at home.
